$comment: Forma component families. Order is navigation order. Each component declares exactly one category in catalog/components/<slug>.mjs; category ids are also URL segments under /components/ and must never collide with a component slug.

categories.name: Actions
categories.summary: Buttons and grouped commands that start work. Forma styles the native control; the application decides what an action does and whether it is currently legal.

categories.name: Form inputs
categories.summary: Native text, date, numeric, range, file and toggle inputs with delegated labels, help text and form participation left to the browser.

categories.name: Selection and choice
categories.summary: Radio- and checkbox-backed choice structures: segmented controls, choice cards, multi-select guidance and hierarchical selection.

categories.name: Assessment and survey
categories.summary: Question shells and response scales that keep Unanswered distinct, keep radio semantics per row, and never compute scores.

categories.name: Navigation
categories.summary: Where am I and where can I go: shells, tabs, pagination, scope trails, trees, wizards and skip links.

categories.name: Feedback and status
categories.summary: Alerts, notifications, validation, loading and progress, and explicit operation states that never collapse unknown into failure.

categories.name: Faults and recovery
categories.summary: The Aegis fault presentation family: safe inline, notification, banner and blocking faults with application-authorized recovery.

categories.name: Overlays and disclosure
categories.summary: Native dialog, Popover API and details/summary surfaces: modal dialogs, edge flyouts, popovers, tooltips, menus and disclosure.

categories.name: Layout primitives
categories.summary: Intrinsic, container-aware composition primitives that recompose by available space without reordering source.

categories.name: Workspaces and shells
categories.summary: Multi-region application compositions: workspace shells, master/detail, split panes, dashboards and record headers.

categories.name: Data display
categories.summary: Tables, ledgers, key-value lists, metrics, timelines, diffs, collections and relationship displays.

categories.name: Workflow and diagrams
categories.summary: Presentation-only building blocks for boards, diagrams and spatial canvases; geometry, routing and editing stay in the application.

categories.name: Command and keyboard-first
categories.summary: Command palette and the CharacterGrid terminal family for keyboard-driven, fixed-cell interfaces.

categories.name: Human–agent interaction
categories.summary: Composer, conversation, understanding review and handoff surfaces that keep agent proposals inspectable and human authority explicit.

categories.name: Attention and verification
categories.summary: Visual Engineering contracts for first-glance priority, bounded emphasis, and recognize-verify-act flows.

categories.name: Security posture
categories.summary: Security results, evidence, exceptions and unknowns presented with explicit text state rather than color-only pass/fail.

categories.name: Site and editorial
categories.summary: The brand-neutral marketing and documentation presentation family: shell, header, hero, sections, cards, prose and footer.

categories.name: Utilities
categories.summary: Small structural helpers: visually hidden text, text roles and other composition aids.

unownedRoots.ef-component-tag: The inert <ef-*> authoring wrapper class. It appears on every component page and is described in the site's 'Reading a component page' guide.
